name: AOD-9604

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A synthetic analogue of the C-terminal 176-191 fragment of human growth hormone, developed for obesity and abandoned after clinical trials failed to show weight-loss efficacy. It holds self-affirmed GRAS status as a food ingredient in the United States but has no drug approval. Clinical development discontinued for lack of efficacy. No FDA drug approval; a self-affirmed GRAS food-ingredient notification is not a drug approval.

systems.note: Taken for lipolysis; the intended effect, though trials did not demonstrate weight loss.
No approved human dosing reference and no product-quality control.

monitors.why: The claimed effect; trials failed to demonstrate it, which is itself the reason to measure.
Confirms the fragment is not producing systemic GH-like effect, as designed.
